title.en: Applications: price ceiling and price floor
title.kn: ಅನ್ವಯಗಳು: ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಲೆ ಮಿತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಲೆ ಮಿತಿ

heading.en: When the government fixes the price

hook.en: Ration shops sell rice below the market price; the government buys wheat from farmers at a minimum support price. What happens to demand and supply then?
hook.kn: ಪಡಿತರ ಅಂಗಡಿಗಳು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಬೆಲೆಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಮಾರುತ್ತವೆ; ಸರ್ಕಾರ ರೈತರಿಂದ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಂಬಲ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಗೋಧಿ ಖರೀದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಗ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪೂರೈಕೆಗೆ ಏನಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?

objectives.en: Explain price ceiling and its consequences
Explain price floor and its consequences

narration.en: Ration shops sell rice below the market price; the government buys wheat from farmers at a minimum support price. What happens to demand and supply then?
narration.kn: ಪಡಿತರ ಅಂಗಡಿಗಳು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಬೆಲೆಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಮಾರುತ್ತವೆ; ಸರ್ಕಾರ ರೈತರಿಂದ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಂಬಲ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಗೋಧಿ ಖರೀದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಗ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪೂರೈಕೆಗೆ ಏನಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?

body.en: A price ceiling is a maximum price fixed by the government, below the equilibrium price, to make essential goods (food grains, kerosene, cooking gas) affordable. At the ceiling, quantity demanded exceeds quantity supplied: a shortage (excess demand). The government then uses rationing (ration cards, fair price shops) to share the limited supply. Problems: long queues, poorer quality, and black markets where the good is sold illegally at higher prices.

points.en: Risks: queues, black market, lower quality

narration.en: A price ceiling is a maximum price below equilibrium. It creates a shortage, which leads to rationing and often a black market.
narration.kn: ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಲೆ ಮಿತಿ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಬೆಲೆಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಿದ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಲೆ. ಇದು ಕೊರತೆ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಪಡಿತರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಳಸಂತೆಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Equilibrium is at price 10 and quantity 200. Now the government sets a ceiling at 6, below equilibrium.
At 6, buyers want 240 but sellers offer only 140. The gap of 100 is the shortage.
Now a floor at 14, above equilibrium. Sellers offer 260 but buyers want only 160: a surplus of 100.

narration.en: Equilibrium is at price 10 and quantity 200. Now the government sets a ceiling at 6, below equilibrium.

body.en: A price floor is a minimum price fixed above the equilibrium price, to protect producers or workers. Examples: the Minimum Support Price (MSP) for crops and minimum wages. At the floor, quantity supplied exceeds quantity demanded: a surplus (excess supply). The government usually buys the surplus to build buffer stocks, which costs money and needs storage; with minimum wages, the surplus of labour means unemployment.

narration.en: A price floor is a minimum price above equilibrium. It creates a surplus, which the government often buys up, as with MSP for wheat.
narration.kn: ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಲೆ ಮಿತಿ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಬೆಲೆಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಲೆ. ಇದು ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಪೂರೈಕೆ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಗೋಧಿಯ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಂಬಲ ಬೆಲೆಯಂತೆ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಅದನ್ನು ಖರೀದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: qD = 300 − 10p and qS = 50 + 15p (equilibrium ₹10). Fix a controlled price and read the shortage or surplus.

problem.en: qD = 300 − 10p and qS = 50 + 15p. Find the shortage or surplus if the government fixes (a) a ceiling of ₹6, (b) a floor of ₹14.

steps.en: (a) p = 6: qD = 240, qS = 140 → shortage of 100 units.
(b) p = 14: qD = 160, qS = 260 → surplus of 100 units.

answer.en: (a) Shortage of 100 units; (b) surplus of 100 units.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. qD = 300 − 10p and qS = 50 + 15p. Find the shortage or surplus if the government fixes (a) a ceiling of ₹6, (b) a floor of ₹14.

body.en: Like a room: the ceiling is low (below equilibrium, shortage) and only matters if it is low enough to hit your head; the floor is high (above equilibrium, surplus) and only matters if it pushes you up.

narration.en: Ceiling below, Floor above. Like a room: the ceiling is low (below equilibrium, shortage) and only matters if it is low enough to hit your head; the floor is high (above equilibrium, surplus) and only matters if it pushes you up.
Demand qD = 300 − 10p and supply qS = 50 + 15p. At what price ceiling is the shortage exactly 100 units?

prompt.en: Demand qD = 300 − 10p and supply qS = 50 + 15p. At what price ceiling is the shortage exactly 100 units?

hint.en: Shortage = qD − qS at the ceiling.

explanation.en: Shortage = qD − qS = 250 − 25p = 100 gives p = ₹6 (below the equilibrium ₹10).

narration.en: Team quiz. Each team discusses quietly and gives one answer.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡವೂ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ.

points.en: Price ceiling: maximum price below p*; causes shortage.
points.kn: ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಲೆ ಮಿತಿ: p* ಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ; ಕೊರತೆ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Shortage leads to rationing and black markets.
Price floor: minimum price above p*; causes surplus.
points.kn: ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಲೆ ಮಿತಿ: p* ಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು; ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: MSP and minimum wages are price floors.
points.kn: ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಂಬಲ ಬೆಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ವೇತನ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಲೆ ಮಿತಿಗಳು.

homework.en: Explain with a diagram the consequences of MSP for wheat being fixed above the market price.

narration.en: Recap. Price ceiling: maximum price below p*; causes shortage. Shortage leads to rationing and black markets. Price floor: minimum price above p*; causes surplus. MSP and minimum wages are price floors.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಲೆ ಮಿತಿ: p* ಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ; ಕೊರತೆ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೊರತೆಯಿಂದ ಪಡಿತರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಳಸಂತೆ. ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಲೆ ಮಿತಿ: p* ಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು; ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಂಬಲ ಬೆಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ವೇತನ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಬೆಲೆ ಮಿತಿಗಳು.
